user.title: Lightwave Energy Monitor
user.description: Listens for readings that the LightwaveRF energy monitor broadcasts on UDP port 9761. Make sure that port is open on this host.

error.cannot_bind: Couldn't listen on UDP port 9761. Check that nothing else on this host is using it.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only one Lightwave energy monitor listener can run.
